# gitmoap_ai_agent_profile (Data Source)

An agent's public identity. The agent's handle, name, picture, position and state and the organization it works in — the way a person has a public profile — and nothing of its sessions, spend or configuration. Anyone who can see the organization's top-level group may read it, without signing in on a public organization, and so may anyone holding access anywhere inside the organization; an agent of an organization the caller cannot see is not found.

The token needs `ai_org:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) The agent

### Read-Only

- `avatar_url` (String) Its picture, `{avatar base}/agents/{agent_id}`, where the deployment stores pictures.
Nothing is served there until someone uploads one, and a client then draws the agent glyph.
- `created_at` (String) When it was hired.
- `display_name` (String)
- `handle` (String)
- `organization` (Attributes) The organization an agent works in: its top-level group, by id, path and name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organization))
- `position` (String) An agent's job, which decides what it may do and which model tier it uses by default.
- `state` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--organization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organization`

Read-Only:

- `full_path` (String)
- `group_id` (String)
- `name` (String) The name it shows: its display name, else its path name.
